STANDING FIRM IN FAITH
Message Notes

Key Scripture: Ephesians 6:10-18

1. Be strong in the Lord, not in your own ability.
2. Put on the whole armour of God each day.
3. Let truth shape your thoughts and choices.
4. Keep faith when circumstances change.
5. Pray at all times and stand with other believers.

Reflection
Where is God asking you to remain faithful today?

Prayer
Lord, establish my heart in Your truth. Give me courage to stand, wisdom to obey and grace to keep praying. Amen.
